en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a large baroque/renaissance-style town hall building featuring a clock tower and onion-shaped turret on the right, and a long row of gabled houses lining a street to the left. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or push carts; a horse-drawn carriage is visible. A small fountain stands in the foreground of the square. German words are painted on the façade of the main building and on a side building.
